title: Bugs
body:
When I add a task or or even make it myself, the app shows it twice in every routine. Also shows a task for Mondays and Fridays on Tuesdays. 
No official facebook or Insta page to consult app agents or read answers to other app users.  
So far not worth the money spent. 

But great idea and nice ready-made routines, if only adding habits from them didn’t duplicate every task.
